components.name: Primary Arcade CTA
components.description: High-contrast gold pill button for primary quiz and conversion actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #FFD600; color: #070811; font-family: 'Chakra Petch', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.95rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em; padding: 14px 26px; min-height: 46px; border: 1.5px solid #FFFFFF; border-radius: 999px; box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(3,4,10,0.45); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.16s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background-color 0.16s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #00E5FF; color: #070811; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00E5FF; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Language / Filter Chip
components.description: Accessible 12px+ pill control for 7-language switching and movement filters.
components.css: .ds-chip { background: #13172E; color: #E4EAFD; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.78rem; padding: 8px 14px; min-height: 38px; border: 1px solid rgba(228,234,253,0.22); border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-chip:hover, .ds-chip.is-active { background: #00E5FF; color: #070811; border-color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FFD600; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Console Option Card
components.description: Selectable world, level, or quiz option tile with crisp 1.5px active bezel.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; text-align: left; background: #13172E; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 14px 16px; border: 1.5px solid rgba(228,234,253,0.18); border-radius: 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.16s ease, background-color 0.16s ease, transform 0.16s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-card:hover { background: #1B2140; border-color: #00E5FF; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00E5FF; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Chakra Petch', sans-serif; font-size: 0.98rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-card-sub { font-family: 'Barlow', sans-serif; font-size: 0.82rem; color: #E4EAFD; }

components.name: VIP Email Field
components.description: 16px mobile-safe email input with Electric Cyan focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #0A0D1C; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: 'Barlow', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; padding: 12px 16px; min-height: 48px; border: 1.5px solid rgba(228,234,253,0.28); border-radius: 12px; caret-color: #00E5FF; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #A3B0D6; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00E5FF; outline-offset: 2px; border-color: #00E5FF; }

components.name: HUD Nav Pill
components.description: Top sticky HUD navigation button with high-contrast active state.
components.css: .ds-nav-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 13px; border-radius: 10px; background: #13172E; color: #E4EAFD; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; border: 1px solid rgba(228,234,253,0.18); transition: background-color 0.14s ease, color 0.14s ease; } .ds-nav-btn:hover { background: #00E5FF; color: #070811; border-color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-nav-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FFD600; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: BodyRush 3D's web interface translates the exact physical sensation of standing 2 meters in front of a glowing 16:9 television in a dim living room: crisp dark obsidian staging so vibrant 3D worlds and neon skeleton telemetry pop immediately, tactile arcade buttons that invite immediate interaction, and instrument-grade clarity for BPM, joint count, duration, and movement rules.
keyCharacteristics: 1:1 In-App Fidelity: Mirrors SuperHotGameView.swift and LevelSelectModalOverlayView.
High-Contrast Dark Telemetry: Pure #070811 dark ink on luminous Gold/Cyan/Emerald actions (>11:1 contrast).
Tabular Data Precision: JetBrains Mono with tabular-nums reserved strictly for BPM, FPS, KCAL, obstacle counts, and durations.
Multilingual CJK + Latin Harmony: Self-hosted Chakra Petch + Barlow paired with native Apple/Android CJK fallbacks.

rules.name: The Dark-Ink-On-Neon Rule
rules.body: Every filled Cyan, Gold, Amber, or Emerald button and badge uses #070811 dark ink—never white text on bright yellow, orange, or cyan, and never colored hover text on a bright fill.

rules.name: The No-Chromatic-Halo Rule
rules.body: Never apply zero-offset colored box-shadow glows or radial background purple blobs; express energy through crisp 1.5px colored borders and directional dark elevation shadows.

rules.name: The 12px Floor Rule
rules.body: No functional label, badge, or body element ever renders below 12px (0.75rem), ensuring effortless legibility on mobile screens and for Japanese/Korean characters.

rules.name: The Data-Only Mono Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is reserved for numbers, BPM, durations, scores, and compact HUD controls—never long paragraphs.

rules.name: The Single-Elevation Declaration Rule
rules.body: Cards declare structural boundaries via crisp 1px–1.5px borders and tonal surface steps; reserve soft dark drop shadows for top-level cabinets and active hover lift, and never nest bordered cards inside bordered cards with duplicate shadows.

dos: Do self-host subsetted WOFF2 fonts (Chakra Petch, Barlow, JetBrains Mono) for zero render-blocking network requests.
Do keep every <video> file untouched at original bitrate (preload="none" + instant responsive .webp poster + Cloudflare 30-day Edge cache).
Do verify >=4.5:1 WCAG AA contrast on every default, :hover, and :focus-visible state, and include visible button text inside aria-label when overriding (WCAG 2.5.3).
Do theme browser defaults (::selection in Electric Cyan #00E5FF with #070811 ink, dark custom scrollbars, tabular-nums).
donts: Don't compress, re-encode, or downscale .mp4 or .webm gameplay videos.
Don't use zero-offset neon box-shadow halos, decorative stripe/grid background gradients, or purple radial glow blobs.
Don't render any UI text below 12px (0.75rem) or leave tags without a valid src, width, and height.
Don't place white or yellow text on bright orange, gold, or cyan fills.
